solution_summary: Hostinger scales conversational AI to help five million global users launch web projects faster while reducing operational costs. Hostinger addresses this challenge with its accessible online platform designed to make digital success simple for creators, bloggers, and small business owners alike. To remove technical friction for its users, the company integrates artificial intelligence directly into its software, allowing creators to describe what they want in natural language to create complete web pages or promotional layouts. “If an automated system takes too long to respond or provides inconsistent results, creators quickly look elsewhere,” explains Saulius Lazaravičius, vice president of product at Hostinger.
